execution_stages.name: Environment and Baseline Ingestion
actions: Ingest 10,000 historical attempts from ADV-001 attack memory (read-only)
Verify SHA-256 integrity of ADV-001 memory
Extract 10 blocked/step-up candidate transactions from test split

execution_stages.name: Multi-Agent Stateful Campaigns
actions: Iterate campaigns 1..10 for each candidate target
Execute 100 rounds per campaign across 5 specialized agents
Evaluate mutations via RedSearchEngine against BlueDetector
Compute multi-objective rewards and assign terminal outcomes
Update private agent state and append to shared memory
Persist atomic checkpoints per round to disk

execution_stages.name: Synthesis and Integrity Verification
actions: Compute aggregate swarm metrics and behavioral adaptation metrics
Verify ADV-001 read-only memory SHA-256 integrity
Persist final metrics.json, adaptation_metrics.json, and evidence package
